title: The Rev.Canon William Parsons Warburton
dates: (1824/5-1913)
---

school inspector

He was educated at Balliol College, Oxford, and was a Fellow of All Souls 1849-53.

He served as HM Inspector of Schools 1851-81, and of training schools 1881-5.

He was an honorary Canon of Winchester 1878-81, and was made a Canon in 1885.

He had three daughters Mary A. (b.1859/60), Katharine (b. 1861/2), and Charlotte (b. 1864/5) [Rugby School Register, Alumni Oxonienses]
